name: HZ_GEO_STRUCTURE_LEVELS_INT
description: HZ_GEO_STRUCTURE_LEVELS_INT is an interface table to load country structure data to TCA geography tables such as HZ_GEO_STRUCTURE_LEVELS, HZ_RELATIONSHIP_TYPES, HZ_GEOGRAPHY_TYPES_B, and HZ_GEOGRAPHY_TYPES_TL.  The program orders data by BATCH_ID, COUNTRY_CODE, and LEVEL_NUMBER to identify a country structure, and LEVEL_NUMBER must start from 1 which is COUNTRY.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for this interface record. (internal use only)

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a geography import batch in HZ_IMP_BATCH_SUMMARY.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Code of country to which the geography belongs.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Unique Identifier Code for the geography type.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: Unique Identifier Code for the geography type.

columns.name: LEVEL_NUMBER
columns.description: Level number of a geography type within a country structure. (i.e. For United States, COUNTRY is 1 and STATE is 2.)

columns.name: PARENT_GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Parent of the geography type (internal use only).

columns.name: ADDR_VAL_LEVEL
columns.description: Address validation level for a country.

columns.name: COUNTRY_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Geography identifier of country which  the geography belongs (Internal use only).

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of geography type (Internal use only).

columns.name: FORWARD_REL_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Forward relationship type identifier of this geography type and its parent geography type in HZ_RELATIONSHIP_TYPES table (internal use only).

columns.name: BACKWARD_REL_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Backward relationship type identifier of this geography type and its parent geography type in HZ_RELATIONSHIP_TYPES table (internal use only).

columns.name: GEO_STRUCTURE_LEVEL_ID
columns.description: Unique geography structure identifier in HZ_GEO_STRUCTURE_LEVELS (Internal use only).

columns.name: INSERT_GEO_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that a new geography needs to be inserted into HZ_GEOGRAPHY_TYPES_B and HZ_GEOGRAPHY_TYPES_TL if it is 'I' (Internal use only).

columns.name: INSERT_REL_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that a new relationship type needs to be inserted into HZ_RELATIONSHIP_TYPES if it is 'I' (Internal use only).

columns.name: INSERT_STRUCT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that a new country structure needs to be inserted into HZ_GEO_STRUCTURE_LEVELS if it is 'I' (Internal use only).

columns.name: ERROR_ID
columns.description: Error ID in HZ_IMP_ERRORS. (internal use only)

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: File import wizard uses this column to relate records in this interface table to rows in a file. (internal use only)

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: File import wizard status: I – In Progress,  O – Obsolete(This would be the status of all the interface table records that were run before),  E - Errored, S - Successful (internal use only)

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: This is an optional column for multi-csv uptake, but recommended. The column saves the individual sys task id for each input csv file, corresponding to value in the mkt_cm_systask table. This value will be populated by the import framework
